note: For the conductor only: the action a gate rehearsal finding's `fix` says in WORDS (a person reads the same text, so it names no script) -> the command that does it; the same file holds the commands of a stand-gap card's environment words (`accept always`, `ask again`, a gap the environment record covers). `<r>` is the task root. Data, not prose in the role file (FR-13). A finding's door (`waives`) is a person's word and is never run from here. `moves` are what the conductor offers when the factory has no move of its own (each priced with the classes of `price_classes`; a `delivery` value is a `words` key of `delivery-verdict-kinds.json` or one of the four non-verdicts of `price_classes.delivery`); `fallback` is what code shows when the conductor cannot answer.

actions.says: the factory re-pins the batch of cases at the bytes on disk (pinning again can make an approved gate A stale, and the answer says so)
actions.run: case_versions.py --task-root <r> --all

actions.says: the factory applies the critic's exact replacements by code and re-pins the case / raises the question and re-pins the case
actions.run: critic_rollcall.py <the critic's findings file> --apply-fixes --task-root <r>

actions.says: the factory writes its readiness record, probing the version control
actions.run: readiness.py --write --probe-vcs

actions.says: the stage-scope read-out shows what the plan dispositions derive
actions.run: controller.py --task-root <r> --operation stage-scope

actions.says: rows go back to qa-test-strategist at S3 / cases go back to qa-case-designer at S4 / the question packet goes back to qa-requirements-tester at S2 / S7 re-triages / a bug candidate (a place the code reads wrong that no executed check covers) goes to the failure analyst at S7 as a bug report (the rework names any case of the approved scope) / the case designer rewrites a `preconditions` line
actions.run: controller.py --task-root <r> --operation rework --stage S<n> --role <that role> [--rows <ids> | --cases <ids>] --reason "<the finding, verbatim>" --brief

actions.says: the S5 critic cannot judge a window because its author's code is defective: the author is sent back over those cases and the critic is retried after
actions.run: story_step.py finish --task <T> --dispatch-id <the running critic> --needs-author <cases of its window> --reason "<what the author must repair>" [--cause <repair cause>]; after the author's finish, controller.py --task-root <r> --operation recover prints the critic's retry packet

actions.says: record it as a finding about the factory
actions.run: project_decisions.py add-finding --essence "<what is wrong>" --scope <local-urgent|local-calibration|upstream-candidate> --witness "<the evidence>" --idempotency-key <key>

actions.says: ask the tracker assistant once, then record what it answered
actions.run: tracker_write.py --record confirmed|no --words "<what it answered>"

actions.says: the person gives each write's tracker id back
actions.run: external_writes.py --record <proposal> --external-id <ID>

actions.says: the factory registers this probe for the profile itself
actions.run: nothing when a driver runs the story: it runs the write from the finding's `argv` field; on a road with no driver the refusal that closes S4 carries the command as `[command: ...]` - run exactly that, once, then close the stage again

actions.says: the person names the container that serves a profile's tests (a runtime-probe card: name the container in your own words, and I check it once now)
actions.run: check it first, read-only: runtime_probe.py --profile <the finding's profile> --environment <the stand> --container <the name> --checkout <the profile's checkout> --app-root /app --task-root <r> --no-evidence, and read the `result` of the ONE JSON line it prints; ONLY when it is `matched`, run the same line with `--suggest --write` in place of `--no-evidence` (the twin of the row above, which registers the probe), once; any other result, a timeout or no JSON: write nothing, tell the person what the check said, in words, and let them name another container; a name docker does not list is refused, never written

actions.says: the person says the application of a profile does not run in a container (a runtime-probe card, or the build question)
actions.run: runtime_probe.py --suggest --write --no-container --profile <the finding's profile> --environment <the stand> --checkout <the profile's checkout>, once; no check for `matched` first: without a container a probe cannot give it. The next stage entry asks the build question

actions.says: the person does not know which build the stand runs (their own words at the build question)
actions.run: project_decisions.py add-finding --essence "<stand, profile, their words>" --scope local-urgent --witness "<the question's text>" --idempotency-key <key>; record no `deployed`. Offer `stop`, or going on without a word: the capture stays refused, and the runner's env_blocked[] row carries the gap to the report by name

actions.says: the factory's helper reads the kept report and records what it changed or understood
actions.run: read the files under the finding's `kept` folder (its manifest.json says what was tried), then ONE of: report_adapt.py kind --profile <the finding's profile> --reader junit-xml|trx --by conductor --task <T> (only a reader that counts a test in the kept report, and only while the profile's report kind is empty), or report_adapt.py understood --profile <the finding's profile> --text-file <file holding what you understood, in words, and any cure you found, with no command, flag, file name or path in it> --by conductor --task <T>; never ask the person for this finding

actions.says: the format needs a reader the factory does not have
actions.run: project_decisions.py add-finding --essence "<the format and what reads it>" --scope upstream-candidate --witness "<the kept report's manifest>" --idempotency-key <key>, then report_adapt.py understood as above

actions.says: the person takes back a recorded environment property (`<name>: ask again`, or in other words)
actions.run: environment_record.py revoke --id EP-<n> --words-file <file>, then waiver.py --revoke --task <T> --stage S5 --block "stand gap: <id>" --words-file <file> for this story's own records of it; `environment_record.py show` lists the ids

actions.says: a lasting answer given in other words (`accept always`)
actions.run: waiver.py --task <T> --stage S5 --block "stand gap: <id>" --words-file <file> (the story's own answer), then environment_record.py record --task <T> --contour <id> --reason <class> --exit-code <the gap's exit_code> --option accept --words-file <file> for a level, or --case <id> --gap <PC id> for a case gap; a gap whose cause is a file or the machine is refused with its reason - never go around it, the story's answer is `accept`

actions.says: a gap the environment record covers is recorded for this story
actions.run: nothing: the driver writes it - waiver.py --task <T> --stage S5 --block "stand gap: <id>" --words-file <file> --by environment-record, and the same for each case of it; run it yourself only when the driver's line says it could not

actions.says: the automator halted at a test file in the application tree
actions.run:
test_locations.py --root . --check --candidate "

" --json, then ask the person in words: for every story or only this one, " files there, without a usual test name" ("at least" if `truncated`). Every story: project_decisions.py add --field-ref /test_locations --essence "test location

" --asked "", then project_decisions.py resolve --id --words-file --resolution-ref " S5" --field-values '{"/test_locations": }'. This story: waiver.py --task --stage S5 --block "protected test path:

" --words-file . No: record nothing

actions.says: `factory_fixable` findings of a gate rehearsal: the driver has already re-pinned the cases and run the critic or designer rework before calling you
actions.run: the driver has already run the re-pin (`case_versions --all`) and the rework; you get only the list code could not repair, and the command and output of one that failed. A finding's `fix` says its action in words: the command is in the rows above (and finalize_task.py <r>, controller.py --operation recover), then answer `continue`: the driver shows the gate once, with what is left stated at its top

actions.says: the person left a source out before the run and now says to read it; only their own words count
actions.run: source_exclusions.py --task <T> --revoke <X-id|as_written> --words "<their words, verbatim>" (`--show` prints the record). The guard closes `--load` and `--revoke` to every role: only the conductor and the orchestrator run them. The entry stays with the person's words; the item goes back to `pending`. Before S1 completes nothing else is yours: the factory fetches the item itself. After S1 completes nothing runs by itself, so the command prints the door: whole commands, in order (for a ticket: peek, then assess with their words, then collect; for a merge request: vcs_evidence.py, then inspect), then the late review. Run them from the project root. A step it names only by a section of phases/s1.md is that section, repeated for that source

actions.says: the story moved to a new key and the person says their earlier words hold there; only their own word starts this
actions.run: waiver.py --carry-from <old key> --task <new key> once S0 of the new key made its folder, before the person answers S1; add --carry-from-root <folder> only for a folder moved by hand. Tell the person each `not carried:` line in words. Run after S1 asked: that question stays asked once more, say so

actions.says: the person gives the names of the two env-file variables that hold the login and the password of a role on the story's stand (`account`, kept for the stand from now on)
actions.run: project_knowledge.py account --task <T> --role <role> --user-key <NAME> --secret-key <NAME> --words-file <file> [--replace]; names only, never a value; the card's own `<id>: accept` (this story only) is the driver's, not this command. The command writes the account into the project's settings first and its record second, and says `recorded (DD-n, PK-n)`; a story that leaves no trace refuses it (the answer stays in the story's words); `project_knowledge.py show` lists what is recorded

actions.says: the person says, in other words, that a role is a role of the product, or is not (a product-role card, or the account card's third answer)
actions.run: project_knowledge.py role --task <T> --role <role> --state known|not_needed --words-file <file>; for `not_needed` ALSO waiver.py --task <T> --stage S5 --block "stand gap: <gap id>" --words-file <file> so this story's cases are reported not run; a story that leaves no trace refuses it

actions.says: the person says, in other words, how a stand holds a side of the product (real, a substitute, not built), whose a side is (this team's or another team's), or that a stand still runs the old version of a side
actions.run: project_knowledge.py side --task <T> --name <side> [--stand <name>] (--reality real|substituted|absent | --deliverable yes|no [--settles-by-file <file>] | --reference) --words-file <file>; the side name is exact (`UI` is not `ui`); a story that leaves no trace refuses it

actions.says: the person takes back a recorded answer about a role or an account (`ask again`, or in other words)
actions.run: project_knowledge.py revoke --task <T> --id PK-<n> --words-file <file>; `project_knowledge.py show` lists the ids; an account value in the project's settings is changed with `account --replace` or by hand; a story that leaves no trace refuses it

actions.says: the person says, in other words, that the product has no such function (a case_environment item)
actions.run: product_gaps.py record --task-root <r> --row <the item's plan row> --gate A --words-file <file>

actions.says: the person takes back a product gap they recorded
actions.run: product_gaps.py revoke --task-root <r> --requirement <R-n> --words-file <file>, then show gate A again

actions.says: the project's dependencies are not installed or differ from its lock, and the factory has the project's own install command (the gate card or the S5 note names it)
actions.run: run the `command` of the `s5_dependencies` note (its `argv` in its `cwd`), once, from the project root; then `dependency_drift.py <project root> --json` must print `in_sync`. Any other result, or no command in the note: write nothing, tell the person in words what the check printed, and offer: install it yourself / go on without the tests of that profile / stop. Never run an install command the note did not name.

actions.says: the person accepts that tests whose probe cannot run here stay unprobed (a probe gap)
actions.run: waiver.py --task <T> --stage S5 --block "probe gap: <case key>" --words-file <file>, once per case key the refusal names; never a line of the refusal and never `*`: the S5 window reads only this word; any one such word covers every test of the story whose check the tool could not read; never a test the code reviewer could not judge

actions.says: the person accepts that tests whose probe the code reviewer could not judge stay not proved
actions.run: waiver.py --task <T> --stage S5 --block "probe not proved: <case key>" --words-file <file>, once per case key the question names; a `probe gap:` word never covers such a test

actions.says: the person told, in their own words, how this project gets more test accounts or which records walkers may share
actions.run: project_decisions.py resolve --id <the DD-n the question names> --words-file <file> --resolution-ref "<T> S6" --field-values '{"/manual/accounts_way": {"words": <their words, whole>, <only the fields their words map: self_sign_up roles, more_accounts as env:U/S key NAMES, limit_by_role>}, "/manual/data_way": {"words": <their words, whole>, <only the pools their words map>}}'; never a value, only key names; a field their words do not say is left out; words that map nothing are still recorded whole. MERGE ON WRITE: resolve assigns the WHOLE value at a pointer, so the object written at each pointer is the project's CURRENT object there (read from the project's `qa-factory/config.json`, the file the reader reads, at that pointer; a deep copy; `{}` when it is not an object) with only the keys this answer sets replaced (`words` always; `self_sign_up` for `the app makes them`; for your own words the fields they map, including data_way.pools); a key the answer does not set stays as the config holds it

actions.says: the person says they added an account for the walkers (the walk_account question) and names the two keys of the env file that hold its login and password
actions.run: names of the two keys only, never a value: project_decisions.py stand-account --role <role> --user-key <NAME> --secret-key <NAME> --words-file <file> for an account of the stand's role, or project_decisions.py resolve --id <the DD-n the question names> --words-file <file> --resolution-ref "<T> S6" --field-values '{"/manual/accounts_way/more_accounts/<role>": [<the role's current env:U/S entries, kept>, "env:<USER_KEY>/<SECRET_KEY>"]}' for an extra account of the role; the list written is the CURRENT list of the role plus the new entry (merge on write, the same rule as walk_supply_way); words that name no two keys record nothing

actions.says: the person answered the data-change question (what the factory may do with data on the stand) in their own words
actions.run: map their words onto exactly ONE of the three option sentences (`only use what exists`, `may create, never delete`, `may create and delete`) and record it: project_decisions.py resolve --id <the DD-n the question names> --words-file <file> --resolution-ref "<T> S6" --field-values '{"/manual/data_way/may": "<the option sentence>"}' (a string; the other data_way keys are not touched, so no merge is needed). Words that map to none of the three are not recorded as a permission: the question stays and you say so in words

factory.record: a record only; no agent works
factory.command: a factory command runs; no agent works
factory.role_round: one more working session of {role}, and its review where the stage has one
factory.conductor: one more session of the conductor
factory.not_known: not known - an estimate, not verified

person.your_work: work of yours outside the factory: {what}
person.your_checks: checks left with you before release: {what}

delivery.unchanged: the delivery verdict stays as the report has it
delivery.waits: delivery waits until this is done
delivery.not_known: what it does to delivery is not known yet
delivery.no_story: no story is touched: an exploration gives no delivery verdict

moves.says: the role that did a stage's accepted work does it again, with the person's words as its instruction
moves.run: controller.py --task-root <r> --operation rework --stage S<n> --role <role> [--cases <ids> | --rows <ids>] [--cause mechanical] --brief --words-file <file> ; the file is the one holding the free-text answer you read in this call, never a file that holds only a token. As an OPTION you offer, `rework` carries "args": {"stage": "S<n>", "role": "<role>", "cases": [<ids>] | "rows": [<ids>], "cause": "<cause>"} from the closed list in the prompt; once the person chooses it the driver runs this rework itself with their original words
moves.precondition: an accepted dispatch of <role> on S<n>; no dispatch running; the story is open; S5-S8 once gate A is decided, S1-S4 before; the stages after S<n> that are completed, and its own review where one was accepted on the cases, run again after it, set aside by the controller in the same move; ids inside the approved scope; never qa-case-critic after gate A. A test_defect round past the repair cap first needs the pass of that round, as the refusal prints it, for BOTH roles (the author's and the critic's): waiver.py --task <T> --stage S<n> --block "<that pass>" --words-file <file> once for each, on the same words, only when those words ask for one more round. --cause mechanical only when the words name a mechanical round; one past its cap, or for a role that is not the author, first needs the pass of that mechanical round, as the refusal prints it, recorded the same way
moves.forbidden_when: the standing decision forbids it (FR-36); a dispatch is running; the story is closed; a delivery attempt is recorded; S1-S4 once gate A is decided; an id is outside the approved scope; the role is qa-case-critic and gate A is decided
moves.records: the rework receipt (its reason is the person's words) and a finding

moves.says: the gate is recorded as approved with the answer you gave
moves.run: nothing: the driver records the gate decision with the words of the answer this question is about, and at gate A applies its card answers first
moves.precondition: the question was raised from an answer at gate A or gate B, and that gate has no current approved decision
moves.forbidden_when: outside a gate; the story is closed
moves.records: the gate decision; its authorization_source is that answer, whole

moves.not_offered: run on the person's own words, never an option: a token answer carries no words
moves.says: the words go to the role that asked, as they were given, and it goes on
moves.run: nothing: answer `continue`; the driver files the words for the dispatch the question names and resumes that role
moves.precondition: the question was about one dispatch and it is still open

moves.says: free a dispatch nobody is doing so the driver starts it again; the new session gets the person's words
moves.precondition: the dispatch is running, blocked, paused, incomplete, returned or abandoned; the new session gets the person's words

moves.says: go on without it; the person's words are recorded as the reason the story carries
moves.run: waiver.py --task <T> --stage S<n> --block "<the block: one of the refusal's lines, whole, or a named block such as `probe gap: <case key>`; waiver.py refuses anything else>" --words-file <file> ; or, for a remark that passes no block, waiver.py --task <T> --remark --stage S<n> --words-file <file>; at the S5 window, a probe gap: the `actions` row for it
moves.precondition: a block a person's word passes

moves.not_offered: the conductor's own move: it runs it with a value a script or the person named; never a person's choice
moves.says: a fact of the story is set
moves.precondition: the value is named by a script or by the person

moves.says: the factory starts the stand with the command the project names for it and checks that it answers
moves.run: the `bring_up` command of the stand in `config.environments[]` ; stand_health.py --probe --env <name>
moves.precondition: the line `Stand remedy:` of the conductor prompt says authorized (story_run.py stand_remedy)

moves.not_offered: run on the person's own words, never an option: a token answer carries no words
moves.says: a source the person left out before the run is read after all
moves.precondition: the person's own words say to read the source; after S1 completes the `exclusions` row of `actions` lists the door

moves.says: the person does the work outside the factory, then tells the factory to look again
moves.run: nothing now: their `retry` makes the factory look again
moves.records: a finding when the cause is the factory's

retry.says: you deal with what is in the way, and the factory looks again

go on.says: go on without it; your words are recorded as the reason the story carries
